hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || { echo "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR not set" >&2; exit 1; }; pnpm run lint:fix > /dev/null 2>&1; OUTPUT=$(pnpm run lint 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUTPUT" >&2; exit 1; fi
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || { echo "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR not set" >&2; exit 1; }; OUTPUT=$(pnpm run check 2>&1); RC=$?; if [ $RC -ne 0 ]; then echo "$OUTPUT" >&2; exit 1; fi
